div.div: Created new branch reorient_nifti in FCP-INDI/CPAC_regtest_pack
Commented on #2267 🐛 Pipeline build freezes when 2 or more skullstripping options are enabled

At a glance, https://github.com/FCP-INDI/C-PAC/blob/266f7a4b7ae18eb91dd406686f4b668c0b25c5f2/CPAC/anat_preproc/anat_preproc.py#L1981-L1996 this NodeBlock is most suspicious to me since it has the same config option as https://github.com/FCP-INDI/C-PAC/blob/266f7a4b7ae18eb91dd406686f4b668c0b25c5f2/CPAC/anat_preproc/anat_preproc.py#L1960-L1975 and has space-T1w_desc-brain_mask as an input

div.div: Pytests: getting error function uses no argument error
singularity run error: No valid /bin/sh in container
For me this suggestion did the trick: when changing Singularity versions, configuration, or installation path, run make clean between make and make install in the installation process.
